description: This file defines the main entry point for the Eclipse Ditto Things Search service. It extends a generic DittoService class with specific configurations and sets up the main actor for the service.

classes.description: Main entry point for the Eclipse Ditto Things Search service, extending DittoService with SearchConfig and setting up actor properties.
